title: Prophetic Guidance on Akhlaq and Truthfulness

text_simplified: The text contains a dialogue between the Prophet ﷺ and one of the Companions about good akhlaq (moral character) and truthfulness. The Prophet ﷺ advises cultivating patience and truthfulness in dealing with others. He also highlights the importance of rifq (gentleness) in speech and action.

review_defects.why: The Arabic mentions two qualities: 'الرفق' (gentleness) and 'اللين' (softness/leniency). The English translation only renders 'rifq (gentleness)' and omits 'اللين' entirely.
